correctness.rationale: The four-gap criterion, integral twelve-term join cycle, exact coface exclusions and unit pairing prove a primitive H^3 class on K8. The min(i,8) simplicial retraction transports it as a split integral summand for all n>=8. Combinatorial Alexander duality gives H_(n-6) of the pure dimension n-5 cut complex, so pure shellability is impossible. The embedded checker independently verifies the oriented cycle and exhaustive finite retractions.

Targeted source and mathematical-record searches returned no equivalent theorem; unindexed work is a residual risk.

value.rationale: A natural sharp structural comparison: all k-cut complexes of squared paths are shellable in the literature, whereas the four-cut complexes of the next path power have a canonical persistent non-top integral class for every n>=8. The primitive class and explicit simplicial retraction explain the obstruction for unbounded n, not an arbitrary finite example.
